title: Web developer in Uruguay | Nahuel Silva
description: I’m Nahuel Silva, a freelance web developer in Uruguay. I design websites, online stores and applications. Explore my work and tell me about your project.
intro: I’m Nahuel Silva, a freelance web developer based in Uruguay. I design and build websites, online stores and applications. Have a project in mind? You can talk directly to me: I’ll help you plan it and handle the development.
heroQuote: Details make the difference. Curiosity does the rest.
aboutText: I’m Nahuel Silva, a frontend developer from Uruguay. My curiosity for the web began at 13, in an HTML workshop. That first encounter with code became a way to explore ideas and bring them to life on screen. Since then, I’ve kept learning and trying new ways to build for the web.
aboutText2: Today I’m a frontend lead and also work as a freelancer, designing and developing websites, online stores and application interfaces. I combine development with UI/UX design and creative coding, from the structure of a page to its interactions and animations.
aboutText3: I like understanding how each project will be used and letting that guide my decisions. I pay attention to clear design, accessibility, performance and code organisation. I especially enjoy the details that give an interface its own character and make it comfortable to use.
servicesIntro: I build websites, online stores, web and mobile applications, interfaces and HTML emails. Each service explains what I do, how I work and what I need to know to get started.

faqList.question: What kinds of websites do you build?
faqList.answer: I build business websites, landing pages, portfolios, online stores and web application interfaces. Explore my featured projects for examples and get in touch to discuss what your business needs.

faqList.question: Do you work with clients across Uruguay?
faqList.answer: Yes. I live in Uruguay and work remotely with clients here and abroad. You talk directly to me throughout the project, from discussing your idea to reviewing progress.

faqList.question: What do you need to estimate a website project?
faqList.answer: Tell me what your business does, what you need the website to do and any examples you like. Your logo, text and images also help. From there, I can explain my approach and put together a quote.

faqList.question: Do you consider SEO and mobile usability?
faqList.answer: Yes. Content structure, headings, metadata, accessibility, performance and mobile layouts are part of development. Search visibility also needs useful content and ongoing work after launch.

ctaLabel: TELL ME WHAT YOU HAVE IN MIND
ctaTitle: I CAN HELP YOU BUILD IT.
ctaText: Have a project in mind? Send me a message and tell me about it. I’ll explain how I can help with your website, online store or application.
